label: is_low_review = min(review_score) <= 2 per order; orders without reviews excluded
train: orders purchased < 2018-01-01, purchase-time features only, order grain
note: ML.EVALUATE uses the default 0.5 decision threshold; with ~13% base rate the model rarely predicts positive at 0.5, hence near-zero recall. ROC-AUC 0.575 is the threshold-free measure, comparable to the local sklearn HGB ROC-AUC 0.601 on the same split.
